description: Each central bank's next rate decision (and decisions of the past week): date, FinChiefs' preview, the research tally (one hike/hold/cut vote per research house — banks, asset managers, independent research firms and podcasts — counted from published notes) with its mix by house type, and the outcome once decided. Pass banks to also list each house with its call and latest note. Covers the G10 banks and India.

banks.description: Central banks by code or short name: fed, ecb, boe, boj, boc, rba, snb, pboc (meetings also cover Riksbank, Norges Bank, RBNZ, RBI). Omit for all.

houses.description: List each research house's call and note (default: true when banks are given, false otherwise).

name: get_central_bank_meetings
title: Get upcoming central bank meetings and the research tally
